name: DWAN SUPPORTS P
notes:
DWAN SUPPORTS P LTD. is a registered Private Limited Company in 2013. Mr. M.D.Ramachandran Nair is the first Managing Director. We had ISP License B class for Kerala and Lakshadweep with effect from 16.7.2014. This has now been upgraded to an A category ISP license for All India with effect from 8.8.16. 

Our plan is to provide broadband services to people at a reasonable rate throughout India. We are making contracts with every cable operators in Kerala in order to reach every home. The cable operators are now using latest Gepon/Gpon technology. Since the backbone is optic Fiber Cable the speed of the Broadband is very good and can provide whatever speed the customer wants. We can alsoprovide 1:1 Premium Bandwidth to those who needs.

We got IP 1 (Infrastructure Provider License) from DOT w.e.f  29/02/16. This license is for making infrastructure like Dark fibre, Telecom tower etc. Our vision is to implement new technologies through internet and intranet to our customers. We wish to use all cable TV networks as the last mile connectivity of our service.

We got Access License (VNO) ( Landline telephone) from DOT wef 13.3.2020

We provide high speed internet with peering and cashing with all major social networks and Leased lines. Also provides IP TV , Mobile TV and voice.
